title: Partial Knee Replacement
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Assess the effusion, since a recurrent effusion after a partial replacement is a finding rather than a stage.
Measure the range, recording any extension deficit, because a partial replacement should restore a good range.
Assess the alignment standing, since a partial replacement does not usually correct a large deformity.
Assess the collateral ligaments, since a partial replacement relies on them.
Assess the cruciate function, because an anterior cruciate deficient knee behaves differently with a partial replacement.
